title: Welcome to HmyhAndroidStarter
body: These posts are bundled with the app and stored in Room, so the list works without a network connection.

title: Room is the source of truth
body: The screen reads posts from the local database. A network refresh only updates what Room already holds.

title: Hilt wires every layer
body: The ViewModel, use cases, repository, DAO, and Retrofit API are all provided through Dagger Hilt.

title: Retrofit refreshes the cache
body: When the server is reachable, posts from jsonplaceholder.typicode.com replace these sample rows.

title: Clean architecture
body: Domain code has no Android, Room, or Retrofit imports. Data maps DTOs and entities to domain models.

title: MVVM with StateFlow
body: The ViewModel exposes an immutable UiState, and Compose collects it with collectAsStateWithLifecycle.

title: Offline first
body: If a refresh fails, the cached rows stay on screen and the error appears above the list.

title: Add your own feature
body: Create feature/<name>/{domain,data,presentation,di} and reuse the shared database and Retrofit instance.
